audit.whatIsWrong: The chart itself is correct and matches the mirror exactly (Ornn/Ornn/Ornn/Skill/Gwen/Gwen/Gwen), but diff read 'EVEN' while diffRating is 8.5/10, tone is the red #ff5d6c and report[14] calls it a hard matchup. report[2].t also called the early 'His early' — wrong owner and wrong gender.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. Her sustain is credited to 'E sustain' and 'E lifesteal'; Skip 'n Slash grants attack speed, range and on-hit magic damage and heals nothing. Hallowed Mist is described as blanket untargetability when Riot's text says she can be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.
audit.why: The heal is A Thousand Cuts (P): 'She heals for a portion of the damage dealt to champions by this effect'. The mist blocks targeting from outside only — walking in is the counterplay, and it is never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Sustain re-attributed in whys[1] and spikes[1].text; the mist's real rule written into report[5].t and dosFull[0].d; on-hit written into dontsFull[0].d.

audit.why: report[8] already carries Mercury's Treads and an early Grievous Wounds component, which is right against A Thousand Cuts' healing.
